description:
You are one of several planners at a logistics company choosing where to build a new regional warehouse. Each planner has surveyed different aspects of the candidate sites.

The options are:
- Site A (Bellyn Vatirtal)
- Site B (Kelynne Ithmir)
- Site C (Ozsan Kesan)
- Site D (Yerwelbel Anslynlu)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which site should be chosen? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

Site A (Bellyn Vatirtal):
  - Site A does not qualify for any tax incentive
  - Site A is in a low-crime area
  - Site A is far from any cargo airport
  - Site A has a clean environmental report
  - Site A saw 9 weather-related road closures last year
Site B (Kelynne Ithmir):
  - Site B faces organised local opposition
  - Site B qualifies for a tax incentive
  - Site B is in a low-crime area

  - Site B is priced at 183 per square metre
  - Site B saw 8 weather-related road closures last year
Site C (Ozsan Kesan):
  - Site C is already zoned for industrial use

  - Site C has a rail spur connection

  - Site C has stable soil for heavy foundations
  - Site C saw 11 weather-related road closures last year

  - Site D has a slow permitting history
  - Site D is close to a cargo airport

  - Site D is 60 minutes from the nearest city centre
